title: Mirabel and the Cipher
author: Wren Lockridge
blurb: Ada Kavanagh, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
